connect.tagline: Check the MeshCore network where you stand: coverage, link quality with nearby repeaters and overall health.
connect.noBluetooth: This browser has no Web Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Edge on desktop or Android.
connect.hint: Turn the Companion on and keep it nearby before pairing.

errors.connectTimeout: Timed out connecting to the node.
errors.unreachable: Node unreachable, check that it is on and in range.
errors.scanUnsupported: Scan refused, update the Companion firmware.
errors.scanFailed: The Companion could not send the scan, try again.
errors.scanNoAnswer: The node did not answer the scan.

scan.autoHint: Scan again every minute while this page is open. | Scan again every {minutes} minutes while this page is open.

reason.nothing-heard: No repeater heard directly in the last {minutes} minutes.
reason.confirmed: {confirmed} usable repeaters confirmed both ways, {solid} solid. | {confirmed} usable repeaters confirmed both ways, {solid} solid.
reason.unscanned: {n} more not scanned yet. | {n} more not scanned yet.
reason.unconfirmed: Scan to confirm the repeaters hear you.
reason.single: One usable repeater, no fallback if it drops.

help.usable: A repeater heard directly in the last {minutes} minutes is usable from +{fair} dB above the floor both ways, solid from +{comfortable} dB. The ring counts the usable ones.
help.levels: Good: {count} usable, one of them solid, confirmed by a scan. Fair: one usable, or not confirmed yet. Weak: only links under +{fair} dB.

repeaters.empty: A scan asks the repeaters in range to answer with how well they hear you. Repeaters that relay traffic are added as their packets come in.
repeaters.showOutOfRange: Show {n} out of range | Show {n} out of range
repeaters.hideOutOfRange: Hide {n} out of range | Hide {n} out of range
repeaters.outOfRangeHint: Repeaters heard directly before that did not answer several scans in a row, and the ones only heard through them.

detail.marginHelp: Relative to the SF{sf} floor of {floor} dB. Fair from +{fair}, comfortable from +{comfortable}.
detail.chartEmpty: The curve shows up with the first packets heard from it.
detail.lastHopOnly: The signal is only measured on the last hop, from the repeater in direct range.
detail.outOfRange: It did not answer several scans in a row, the values below are the last ones.
detail.relayedOutOfRange: The repeater it was last heard through is out of range, and it was not heard since.

chart.summary: SNR of the last packet heard, from {min} to {max} dB. The SF{sf} floor is {floor} dB. | SNR of the last {n} packets heard, from {min} to {max} dB. The SF{sf} floor is {floor} dB.

terrain.title: Terrain to the repeater
terrain.throttledHelp: Open-Meteo caps its free requests per minute, hour and day for each device. The profile comes back once the quota renews.

explain.marginal: The gap to the Fresnel zone is smaller than the uncertainty of the terrain (90 m cells) and of the positions. Trust the measured signal instead.
explain.clear: The terrain leaves the useful Fresnel zone clear. A weak signal would come from something else: buildings, trees, the antenna.
explain.partial: The ground stays below the line of sight but cuts into the Fresnel zone. Expect a few dB of loss, more in damp weather.
explain.blocked: A ridge rises above the line between you and the repeater. The signal only gets through by diffraction or reflection.

terrain.groundBelow: Ground below the line of sight
terrain.groundAbove: Ground above the line of sight
terrain.needed: {height} m must stay clear below the line
terrain.chartShortfall: Terrain over {length}. {verdict}. At the tightest point, {distance} away, {height} m short.
terrain.chartSpare: Terrain over {length}. {verdict}. At the tightest point, {distance} away, {height} m to spare.
terrain.heightsHelp: Above the ground. Yours applies to every repeater, the repeater's to this one only, on this device.
terrain.pending: Heights changed, the profile is not updated yet.
terrain.invalid: Enter a height from 0 to {max} m.
terrain.source: Terrain {dem} via {api}, 90 m. Earth curvature k = 4/3, {frequency} MHz.

companion.readFailed: Could not read the node, try again.

checks.marginDetail: The last packet came in at {snr} dB SNR, the SF{sf} floor is {floor} dB. Under {fair} dB of margin, packets start getting lost.
checks.clockOkDetail: The node clock matches this device.
checks.clockOffDetail: The node clock differs from this device. Its messages and adverts carry wrong timestamps.
checks.errorsSinceBootDetail: {n} packet heard since boot could not be decoded, usually weak or colliding signals. | {n} packets heard since boot could not be decoded, usually weak or colliding signals.
checks.errorsSessionDetail: {n} packet heard since you connected could not be decoded, usually weak or colliding signals. | {n} packets heard since you connected could not be decoded, usually weak or colliding signals.

quota.reached: Open-Meteo quota reached, terrain and altitudes are unavailable for now.

wakeLock.label: Stay awake
wakeLock.hint: Keep the screen on while the app is shown.
wakeLock.refused: The browser refused to keep the screen on.

history.title: Last {count} sessions
history.hint: Kept on this device. Each connection to the companion makes a session, the oldest is removed once there are more.
history.betaHint: This feature is still being tested: recorded sessions may change or be cleared in a future version.
history.empty: No session yet. Each connection to the companion is recorded here with the repeaters heard and the coverage at each scan.
